title: IT Sales Executive
description:
IT Sales Executive

Horley, Surrey

We are seeking anl IT Salespeople to join our dynamic team. This role is ideal for individuals looking to build a career in IT sales and further develop their skills in a supportive environment. You will be responsible for engaging with potential clients, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions. As you build your area of the business, there will be an opportunity to develop your own team.

Responsibilities
- Engage with potential clients through various communication channels to promote

our products and services.
- Conduct needs analysis to understand client requirements and recommend

appropriate solutions.
- Maintain accurate records of client interactions using our CRM tools.
- Collaborate with other team members to achieve sales targets and contribute to

overall team success.
- Provide exceptional customer service by addressing client queries and resolving

issues promptly.
- Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance sales techniques and

product knowledge.
- Share your knowledge with other members of the Team.
- Assist in the development of marketing strategies to attract new clients.
- Basic salary + uncapped commission

Qualifications
- Proven IT sales experience in hardware, software, cybersecurity, cloud or

infrastructure and a desire to learn and grow within the industry.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to build

rapport with clients.
- Proficiency in analysing customer needs and providing tailored solutions.
- Familiarity with CRM/CPQ platforms.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, demonstrating initiative and

enthusiasm.
- A positive attitude and willingness to embrace challenges in a fast-paced

environment.
- Join us as we strive for excellence in sales while providing exceptional service to our

clients!
- Pay: circa £30 K AAE + commission

Benefits:
- Casual dress
- Company events
- Company pension
- Employee mentoring programme
- Free parking
- On-site parking
- Schedule:
- Monday to Friday

title: AV Sales Account Manager
company: Kenneth Brian Associates Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Kenneth Brian Associates are recruiting for an ambitious Business Development Manager to join a growing technology and AV solutions provider.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proven B2 B sales professional to develop and manage relationships whilst driving new business and growing existing accounts.

£40-50k basic + uncapped commission, with realistic OTE of £60-70k in year one.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing and developing your own portfolio of clients
- Responding to inbound enquiries and generating new business opportunities
- Producing quotations and proposals
- Building long-term customer relationships
- Managing account renewals and ongoing client support
- Working closely with internal teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

Requirements
- Minimum 3 years' B2 B sales experience within technology
- Proven track record of achieving sales targets
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Interest in technology and AV solutions
- Full UK driving licence

What's on Offer?
- Warm leads and existing client opportunities
- Career development and progression
- Supportive team environment and regular social events

If you're looking to join a forward-thinking technology business where you can genuinely make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Customer Service / Key Account Sales Advisor to join their friendly, close-knit team. This role offers the perfect mix of customer service, telesales, and account management, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships and driving sales.

Salary: £27,000

Hours: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm ( hour lunch) with some flexibility to be discussed

Location: Redhill

The Role

You will act as the first point of contact for customers, ensuring a smooth and efficient service while maximising sales opportunities. Alongside handling day-to-day enquiries, you will be responsible for managing your own portfolio of key accounts covering multiple practices, some with regular purchasing needs and others requiring more proactive contact.

Key responsibilities include:
- Handling customer queries with professionalism and patience, including delivery issues, order errors, and stock availability.
- Processing orders quickly and accurately.
- Building rapport with customers and promoting additional products through upselling and link-selling.
- Managing a portfolio of client accounts, ensuring each practice is contacted regularly with updates on promotions and special offers.
- Working to grow sales across your accounts on a quarterly basis, with a focus on targeted product campaigns.
- Carrying out administration tasks such as processing emailed orders and maintaining accurate account records.
- Collaborating closely with a small, supportive team while confidently managing your own workload.

About You

Our client is looking for someone who has:
- Strong customer service and telephone skills with a calm, professional approach.
- Experience in telesales, account management, or a similar customer-facing role.
- Confidence in upselling, link-selling, and building lasting client relationships.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage diaries, accounts, and admin tasks efficiently.
- A proactive, team-focused attitude and the ability to work independently.

If you are a motivated customer service professional with a talent for relationship-building and sales, we would love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Advisors
description:
Looking for a customer service role that can grow into a long-term career?

Insure Recruitment is delighted to be supporting an award-winning insurance business that is expanding its Customer Service team with two exciting opportunities for enthusiastic, customer-focused individuals.

If you have customer service or telephone-based experience, this is a fantastic opportunity to build a rewarding career in insurance with full training, ongoing support and progression opportunities.

What's on offer?
- £25,000 salary.
- Hybrid working, minimum three days in the office and two days from home (after successfully your three-month probation).
- Company laptop and headset provided.
- Team bonus scheme- earn up to £450 when monthly team commission targets are exceeded (subject to quality measures after probation).
- Perkbox membership with discounts on shopping, restaurants, cinemas and gyms.
- Professional development and funded learning opportunities.
- Annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday.
- Interest-free season ticket loan.
- Life assurance.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits.
- A supportive, collaborative team environment with clear career progression.

The role

As an Insurance Customer Service Executive, you'll be the trusted first point of contact for customers, providing outstanding service while helping them find insurance solutions that meet their needs.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Advising customers on insurance cover options and arranging suitable policies.
- Providing quotations and processing payments.
- Handling customer enquiries professionally and empathetically.
- Accurately updating customer information across internal systems.
- Supporting customer retention and identifying cross-selling opportunities.
- Working in line with FCA guidelines and company quality standards.
- Completing structured training and on-the-job learning to develop your insurance knowledge.

Who are we looking for?
- At least one year of office, customer service or telephone-based experience
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- A positive, team-oriented approach
- Confidence using computer systems and managing customer interactions
- A genuine desire to build a career in insurance

Insurance experience is an advantage, but it isn't essential. We're looking for people with the right attitude, strong customer service skills and a willingness to learn.

After successfully completing your probation, you'll become eligible for the team bonus scheme. For example, if the team achieves 5% above its monthly commission target, you could receive a £450 bonus, subject to meeting quality standards, including no failed calls during the month and achieving your individual cross-selling targets.

Start your insurance career today!

These are two fantastic opportunities to join a business that genuinely invests in its people through structured training, continuous development and long-term career progression.

At Insure Recruitment, we're proud to work with clients who are committed to building diverse, inclusive and authentic workplaces. If this role excites you, but your experience doesn't match every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you- you could be exactly who we're looking for!
